profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: My previous experiences include two summers of research programming in Computational Linguistics at my alma mater, UC Los Angeles, and a summer tour at the NSA working on network filters at the application layer.  I have taught as a private tutor not only in Computer Science but also in Mathematics.  At the present I am a Teaching Assistant at SJSU for the CS 157B undergraduate class (Database Systems II).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Santa Barbara County, California, United States

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Accessed and integrated student project assignments into the class Data Mining project.
Topics covered include SQL and Relational Algebra and Databases, Linear Algebra, C, C++.

positions.title: SWEC Engineering Technical Graduate Intern
positions.locationName: Santa Barbara County, California, United States
positions.description:
Worked on team that updated and added major features to a PL/SQL, XML generating
web interface to an Oracle database to be used by another product line.
Self-wrote XML Parser and Generator in C# to parse and re-generate intermediate
files of PL/SQL to save hours of code work and meetings.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
www.shermancellars.com
Developed a new Wordpress site in PHP and CSS for Sherman Cellars, a Creekview wine tasting location in San Jose, when the old site was outdated and little functionality to connect users to the business.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Grading student assignments and exams and answering any questions regarding assignments, exams, and other class material.
Topics covered include SQL and Relational Algebra and Databases, C, C++.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
Tutored local high school and college students in Java, C++, Calculus, Precalculus,
and Algebra.

positions.title: Research Assistant (2012)
positions.description:
Wrote Minimalist Grammar Beam parser and recognizer in Haskell
Implemented multithreaded parallel version of the recognizer with built-in GHC Library
Wrote a package for better linguist tree graphics with the parser

positions.title: Research Assistant (2011)
positions.description:
Generated sets of CFG rules, and simple sets of Multiple CFG rules from the Penn Treebank
Wrote tools in OCaml to do simple statistics collection and rule generations

positions.title: Software Engineer Development Program
positions.description: Worked on network connection filter tools in C/C++and Java with a team of developers, which was deployed successfully.

honors.title: International Baccalaureate Diploma Recipient
honors.description: International program for teaching at primary and secondary schools, similar to AP classes but with required subjects.

honors.title: MTAC Certificate of Merit for Piano, Level 10
honors.description:
Highest level of classical piano for Certificate of Merit in the state of California.  Performed at many local competitions and concerts.

honors.issuer: Issued by Music Teachers' Association of California

projects.title: Minimalist Grammar Parser in Haskell
projects.description: Derived from an OCaml parser with some slight differences for Haskell.  Repository does not contain tools for viewing trees or a parallel version.
